name: DALL-E 3
description: DALL-E 3 is OpenAI's most advanced image generation model, accessible via ChatGPT and the OpenAI API. It greatly improved prompt adherence compared to DALL-E 2, faithfully rendering complex scenes, accurate text, and fine details. Integrated directly into ChatGPT, users can refine images with conversational follow-up prompts. The API enables programmatic access with automatic content policy enforcement.
pricingDetails: Available via ChatGPT Plus ($20/month). API: $0.04–$0.12 per image depending on quality and resolution.
